name: 00_Cerebrum
notes: The vault machinery with no corpus: the operating manual, WHY.md, the OKF v0.2 spec, the knowledge-base template, three skills and 43 scripts. Build 25: the vault's week to 05.10.2026. One module, bundle.py, now says what a bundle is for every script, and blanklines.py holds the blank-line rules for the audit and its three repairs. verify-cases.py keeps a made-up failing case for each check the audit makes of a knowledge base, and verify.py runs them on every commit. pairs.py lists the contradiction candidates nobody has read since either side changed, changed-pages.py the concepts written before a page they cite was rewritten, and quotes.py the quotations that stand in no page their footnotes cite. The commit hook runs viewer-check.js when a commit changes the viewer. The launcher offers the sign-in from seven days before the login ends. Settings lists a OneNote sync job and the health checks with the scheduled tasks. promote-drafts.py is gone. Build 23: the graph draws every knowledge base round rather than as a line, by raising a stretched group's gravity until its layout is round, and viewer-check.js checks it. Build 21: the viewer's helper offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, and viewer-check.js keeps a running helper out of its Settings geometry checks, which a late answer from it could fail. Build 19 ships the launcher, Open 00_Cerebrum.command, which the viewer already pointed to, and an icon for it drawn from the viewer's mark on a demo vault, so _scripts/set-icon.sh works; build 17 shipped the script without either. Build 17: the concept list groups by knowledge base; Settings shows the Claude app's scheduled tasks; the viewer takes its view and search from its address; a small knowledge base gets a minimum radius on the map; verify.py gains three gauges (content stranded after the footnotes, descriptions behind their sources, source stamps older than the file they cite) and a check of each Raw register; meetings.py reads meeting notes without their transcripts; frozen knowledge bases are left out of the plural runs; and a vault-scoped report can be given a home with VAULT_REPORT_KB. Build 11 brought the 3D view. Unpack it, run python3 _scripts/verify.py, and add a knowledge base from _KB_CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md.
